findings.title: Array parameter passed to `= ANY(...)` expands into a scalar list and produces invalid SQL
findings.body: Prisma.sql serializes a JS array interpolated into a template as a comma-separated list of placeholders ($1, $2, ...), not as a single Postgres array parameter. So `("teamId" = ANY(${teamIds}))` becomes `"teamId" = ANY($1, $2, $3)`, which Postgres rejects with a syntax error. The same problem affects the user-id `ANY(...)` clauses at lines 168, 201 and the team-scope clause. Any org or team scoped insights query will fail at runtime. Use `ANY(${Prisma.join(ids)})` is also wrong for ANY; the array must be cast to a single array parameter (e.g. `ANY(${ids}::int[])` via a helper that binds a single array value, or `IN (${Prisma.join(ids)})`). The unit tests only compare Sql objects, so they do not catch this.

findings.title: Team-scope user clause has the same ANY(array) expansion bug
findings.body: `Prisma.sql`("userId" = ANY(${userIdsFromTeam})) AND ("isTeamBooking" = false)`` interpolates a JS array, which Prisma expands into individual placeholders, producing invalid SQL for `= ANY(...)`. Team-scoped queries that have members will error out instead of filtering.

findings.title: getBaseConditions returns unparenthesized OR expressions when only one side exists
findings.body: When only authConditions or only filterConditions is present, the method returns the fragment as-is. The org auth condition and the eventType filter are top-level ORs (`A OR B`). Callers embedding the result in a larger WHERE with AND (e.g. `WHERE x = 1 AND ${base}`) get wrong precedence and can leak rows. The combined branch wraps in parentheses, but the single-fragment branches do not, so the result is inconsistent. Wrap every returned fragment in parentheses.

findings.title: Public findMany method removed without replacement in this change
findings.body: The `findMany` method, which applied the authorization and filter conditions to a Prisma query, was deleted and replaced by `getBaseConditions` returning raw SQL. Any existing caller of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` (routers or other services) will now fail to compile or run. The PR does not show these callers being updated, and the description does not mention the API change.

findings.title: Only one integration test exercises the SQL, and it covers a single scenario
findings.body: The `toEqual(Prisma.sql...)` assertions compare the template object structure, so they confirm string shape but not that the SQL is valid or returns correct rows. The only `$queryRaw` test covers one user-scoped case. Nothing runs the org or team scope SQL against Postgres, which is why the ANY(array) bug above goes unnoticed. Add database-backed tests for org and team scopes and for the OR-combined conditions.

findings.title: Caching tests were deleted without explanation
findings.body: The 'Caching' describe block (cache authorization conditions, cache filter conditions) was removed entirely. The service still caches these values, so the behavior is untested now. The PR description does not mention the removal.
